description: This file is a bash script defining functions to manipulate git repository states, such as setting, saving, and verifying file content in worktrees and index, as well as saving and verifying the git HEAD revision.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the content of a file in the worktree and stages it in the index.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current contents of a file in the worktree and in the index to separate backup files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Performs set_state and then saves the state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that the worktree and index contents of a file match expected contents.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved states match the current worktree and index contents.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD revision hash.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD hash matches the saved one.
